sections.heading: How it works
sections.intro: Three steps. No haggling, no hidden fees, no strangers test-driving your car.

items.title: Get your valuation
items.body: Enter your reg and mileage. You'll get a guaranteed price based on live market data, not a teaser figure that drops on the day.

items.title: Book a free inspection
items.body: Pick a time at one of our Manchester sites, or we'll come to you. It takes about 20 minutes.

items.title: Get paid the same day
items.body: Once the inspection's done we transfer the money instantly and handle the V5C paperwork for you.

sections.heading: A fair price, without the hassle
sections.body:
Selling privately means time-wasters, test drives with strangers and payment risk. Part-exchange often hides a low offer inside a new-car deal.

We buy outright, at a price we commit to upfront. If the inspection matches what you told us, that’s what you’re paid, and we’ll settle any outstanding finance directly with your lender.

sections.heading: See what your car is worth in 60 seconds
sections.body: No obligation to sell, and your valuation is guaranteed for 7 days.

items.question: How do you work out my valuation?
items.answer: We use live auction and retail data for your make, model, age and mileage, then factor in the condition you describe. The figure you see is the figure we pay, as long as the inspection matches.

items.question: Can I sell a car with outstanding finance?
items.answer: Yes. We settle the finance directly with your lender and pay you any balance on the same day. If you owe more than the car is worth, we’ll tell you upfront.

items.question: What documents do I need?
items.answer: Your V5C logbook, photo ID, both sets of keys and the service history if you have it. We’ll take care of notifying the DVLA.

items.question: How quickly will I be paid?
items.answer: Payment is made by bank transfer as soon as the inspection is complete and the paperwork is signed, usually within an hour.

items.question: What happens if the inspection finds something I missed?
items.answer: We’ll explain exactly what we found and give you a revised price on the spot. You’re under no obligation to accept it, and there’s no charge if you walk away.
